contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Complementary to corroborated FND-0131 rather than a duplicate: Stacks 0FWG shows that for a finite module that is not already locally free, a locally constant residue-field rank function implies local freeness only after reducedness, which is exactly FND-0131; FND-0146 is the different reducedness-free statement for a morphism of sheaves that are already finite locally free. Compatible with FND-0122 (I_11(phi)=I_5(phi_5)=O_B on any locally Noetherian base), which applies the maximal-minor conclusion to a rank-at-least-r evaluation map and is not a merge target. Primary check: Stacks 07ZC equates Fit_k not contained in p with fiber dimension at most k; if d tensor kappa(t) is injective at every point then the rank(K^0) minor ideal lies in no prime, hence equals (1). On the resulting Zariski cover a maximal minor is a unit, so d admits a local left inverse and is a split injection; in particular ker(d)=0. No reducedness or Noetherian hypothesis is used. This is the scheme-theoretic constant-rank step FND-0131 requires before kernels or pushforwards can be declared locally free over a nonreduced base. Distinct from FND-0131 and FND-0122: do not merge. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source.
